scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/**/*.test.js
scripts.generate:viewer: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js portrait . --output viewer/public/portrait.svg --mvp-grammar
scripts.build:viewer: npm run generate:viewer && vite build viewer
scripts.smoke:viewer:enabled: ANTHESIS_VIEWER_ENABLED=true npm run build:viewer && ANTHESIS_EXPECT_VIEWER_ENABLED=true node scripts/smoke-viewer.mjs
scripts.smoke:viewer:disabled: npm run build:viewer && ANTHESIS_EXPECT_VIEWER_ENABLED=false node scripts/smoke-viewer.mjs
